definitions: A set of written or printed pages fastened together along one side and encased between a protective cover.
A division of a larger work, such as a chapter of a novel or a section of a legal code.
A record of wagers made, especially in gambling.
A book-shaped object containing blank pages for notes, drawings, or autographs.
examples: I am reading a fascinating book.
He keeps a book on all the horse races.
She sketched in her new book.
